captures.title: Mirror review wedge: replace unbounded until-poll with a bounded wait (root cause)
captures.note: ROOT CAUSE of the recurring Mirror review wedges (2026-06-26): Mirror review sessions background a long command (regression check / subagent) and poll its output file with an UNBOUNDED until-loop: until [ -s <task>.output ] && grep -qE 'verdict|timed out|Traceback' ...; do sleep 15; done. Fix = bounded wait with a wall-clock timeout (the system already ships scripts/wait_for_pid.sh for exactly this) — find where this poll is generated (Mirror CLAUDE.md review procedure or a helper) and replace the unbounded until with a timeout.
